scope: offline release-candidate validation; no live deployment, push, restart or public upload
scientific_selection: frozen v10 single checkpoint; glass v0 audit found preprocessing leakage, strict glass v1 rebuilt with fixed original hyperparameters and train-only scaling; no audit-driven checkpoint selection

optimization.comparison: same frozen predictor, search space, objective definitions and counted model evaluations; also retain unchanged live-default baseline

release_policy.research: may run diagnostics privately with limitations retained
release_policy.shadow: requires software parity, privacy, real health probes, bounded resource use and rollback
release_policy.primary: requires domain/property evidence, task-definition match, calibrated support, provenance/license approval and deployment approval
